verdict.rationale: Docs show that intentions and tasks carry short reference identifiers (e.g., 'Foreloop-Intention: YOUR-REF') and that the CLI can manage 'Projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks from a terminal', implying named/ref-addressable entities, but there is no explicit command or UI feature shown for directly jumping to/opening a feedback item, task, or initiative by typing its short name. Missing for 10: a documented 'jump to' or quick-open command, evidence of short-name-based lookup in CLI/UI, and any hands-on demonstration of this navigation flow.
